status: Root source review complete; import also requires three completed full-language reviews.
review_scope: Main reviewer fully read all Chinese body paragraphs in this five-essay batch. Language reviewers separately read each complete assigned manuscript and Chinese source, repairing precise language issues while preserving every paragraph, argument, concrete example and limitation. These are ethical/philosophical essays, not personalized legal or medical advice. Two incomplete/ambiguous Chinese constructions in essay14 paragraph30 and essay15 paragraph17 were clarified and explicitly checked across all eight languages; no exhaustive external empirical audit is claimed.

edits.zh: 它可以是更大的决定空间、明确的学习时间、合理的工作量调整，也可以是让贡献被真实记录，而不是在效率提高以后，因为看起来“并没有做那么多”就低估这份贡献。
edits.hant: 它可以是更大的決定空間、明確的學習時間、合理的工作量調整，也可以是讓貢獻被真實記錄，而不是在效率提高以後，因為看起來“並沒有做那麼多”就低估這份貢獻。
edits.en: It can mean greater room to decide, designated learning time, reasonable workload adjustments, or an accurate record of the contribution, rather than discounting that contribution because the person now appears to have “not done very much” after efficiency improves.
edits.reason: The Chinese source ends with the unfinished construction 而不是把…看起来. Restore the missing judgment/action: do not undervalue the contribution merely because greater efficiency makes the work look lighter. All four forms of recognition remain. This is a grammar clarification, not a new thesis.

edits.zh: 既然随时可以找到别人，便不必认真培养；既然岗位比个人重要，便不必回应异议；既然离开不会影响系统，也似乎不必为了人的健康和边界调整工作安排。
edits.hant: 既然隨時可以找到別人，便不必認真培養；既然崗位比個人重要，便不必回應異議；既然離開不會影響系統，也似乎不必為了人的健康和邊界調整工作安排。
edits.en: Since someone else can be found at any time, there is no need to invest seriously in people's development; since the role matters more than the individual, objections need no response; since someone's departure will not affect the system, there seems to be no reason to adjust the work to protect people's health and boundaries either.
edits.reason: Clarify an omitted object in the criticized reasoning: it is work arrangements that should accommodate people's health and boundaries, not health and boundaries themselves that should be adjusted. EN/ES final reviewers had already correctly expressed this meaning.
